Diane Vernesoni Topsham LD 1594
I URGE YOU TO VOTE OUGHT TO PASS on LD1594, An Act to Change the Appropriation for the Governor's Expense Account and Create Transparency in Expenditures Made from That Account. Any time you create transparency when dealing in money it is a very good thing, especially in government. The government likes to spend our money in less than efficent ways. Reducing the expense accounts by $10,000 is also a very good idea. There is way too much spending of hard-earned taxpayer monies in my estimation. Having access given to the public to monitor what is going on is also a GREAT IDEA. It certainly will make some people make sure an expense is necessary before approving it because their reelection may depend upon that. Please, help get our government in the business of letting their constituents know what their government is doing with their money. Please vote OUGHT TO PASS on LD1594. Our pocketbooks THANK YOU VEY MUCH!
